karats.label: 24k
karats.blurb: Our 24k gold leaf is 99.9% gold, available as transfer and loose leaf books and in heavier double, triple and quad leaf. 24 karat gold is especially popular for gilding projects which require purity and durability, especially outdoor projects and religious iconography.

karats.label: 23.75k
karats.blurb: Our 23.75k gold leaf has a slightly softer tone when compared to our 24k gold leaf. It comes in transfer leaf and loose leaf books, and in standard, double, and triple leaf. Our triple leaf is ideal for all outdoor applications.

karats.label: 23k
karats.blurb: 23k gold leaf is one of the more popular colors. We have it in transfer and loose leaf books, in both standard and double leaf, from Voltarra and from Noris, plus a red gold.

karats.label: 22k
karats.blurb: 22k gold leaf is 91.8% gold with silver and copper added, which gives it a lighter color than leaf with a higher gold content. Moon gold and rose gold are also 22 karat.

karats.label: 18k
karats.blurb: 18k gold leaf is an alloy of 75% gold and 25% silver, which gives the leaf a bright yellow color. Because of the high silver content, 18k leaf must be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.

karats.label: 12k
karats.blurb: 12k gold leaf is 51% real gold with silver and palladium added, which produces a silver-colored leaf with a touch of color, also known as white gold. It must be sealed to keep it from tarnishing.

collections.label: Silver, copper & palladium
collections.blurb: Genuine silver, copper and palladium leaf, in loose and transfer leaf, plus copper rolls.

collections.label: Imitation gold & silver
collections.blurb: Imitation gold leaf (copper and zinc, also called Dutch metal) and imitation silver leaf (aluminum), in loose and transfer leaf and in rolls, with variegated leaf for color effects.

collections.label: Roll leaf
collections.blurb: Leaf placed on a tightly wound roll of transfer paper, so you unroll it onto the prepared surface instead of placing individual leaves. Ideal for long stripes, large surfaces and architectural installations.

collections.label: Variegated leaf
collections.blurb: Imitation gold leaf exposed to heat and chemicals to produce colored patterns, in two colors.

collections.label: Powder, shell, flake & scrap
collections.blurb: Gold in other forms: powder and shell gold for detailed work, cosmetic grade flake, scrap, and mini bundles of small loose leaves.

collections.label: Heavy leaf
collections.blurb: Double, triple and quad thickness leaf, for outdoor and architectural work. Triple leaf is recommended for outdoor projects.

collections.label: Gilding tools
collections.blurb: Everything for laying and finishing leaf: burnishers, tips, brushes, knives and cushions, plus kits and specialty tools.

collections.label: Gilding supplies
collections.blurb: Sizes and adhesives, primers, sealers, clay bole, paints, and Kölner gilding products.

collections.label: Agate burnishers
collections.blurb: Highly polished genuine agate burnishers on lacquered wooden handles, for polishing gold, silver or other leaf on water gilded surfaces. Each number is a different shape and tip. Made in Germany.

collections.label: Gilder's tips
collections.blurb: Tips for picking up and placing leaf: squirrel hair, synthetic, and the Thorn Tip for glass and flat surfaces.

collections.label: Gilding brushes
collections.blurb: Brushes for applying size, primer, sealer and paint, and for removing excess leaf.

collections.label: Pinstriping brushes
collections.blurb: Striping and scroll brushes in squirrel hair and synthetic hair, for lettering and pinstriping.

collections.label: Gilder's knives
collections.blurb: Stainless steel knives for cutting leaf on a gilders cushion.

collections.label: Gilder's cushions
collections.blurb: Suede cushions (also called pads) for cutting leaf, in tabletop and handheld styles, plus a pad and knife combo.

collections.label: Gilding kits
collections.blurb: Instacoll kits and a fine detail kit for getting started.

collections.label: Other tools
collections.blurb: Un-rollers for roll gold, the Instacoll tool and tissues, a gold removal pad, a wash bottle and a pipette.

collections.label: Size & adhesives
collections.blurb: Oil, water and flexible sizes and adhesives for every surface, from Quick and Slow Size to Kölner Instacoll and Permacoll.

collections.label: Basecoat primer sealer
collections.blurb: Oil-base primer sealers in yellow, red and gray, to prepare a surface for size. The color changes the tone of the leaf.

collections.label: Topcoat sealers
collections.blurb: Acrylic and water-base topcoats that prevent tarnish and oxidation on low-karat, silver, imitation and variegated leaf.

collections.label: Sinopia clay bole
collections.blurb: Clay bole in colors for water gilding, applied over gesso to give the leaf its color tone.

collections.label: Kölner gilding products
collections.blurb: German gilding products from Kölner: Instacoll, Permacoll, Miniatum and more, with their tools and kits.

collections.label: Caselo casein paints
collections.blurb: Water-based Kölner casein paints used for restoration and as a base coat when gilding.

collections.label: Kölner Poliment
collections.blurb: Kölner Poliment clay bole for water gilding, which enhances the tone and luster of the gold.

collections.label: Gesso, kaolin & more
collections.blurb: Gesso, kaolin powder, gum arabic, and the gold leaf color chart.

products.name: Voltarra Silver Leaf
facts: Genuine silver
3-3/4 in square
loose and transfer / patent
about: Our genuine silver leaf is 99.9% silver. It can be used for picture frames, indoor architectural projects like ceilings or walls, and many types of artwork.

Silver leaf has a bright metallic white finish that can be toned down, or antiqued, by using sealers with color added. Silver leaf MUST be sealed or it will tarnish. Consider 12k gold leaf if your project requires a warmer silver toned color, or palladium leaf, which has a silvery appearance, but does not need to be sealed.

products.name: Copper Leaf
facts: Genuine copper
6-1/4 in square
loose and transfer / patent
about: Copper Leaf is made from 99.9% copper. Copper Leaf is thicker than genuine gold and silver leaf, and can be gently handled with clean, dry and oil-free, hands.

To maintain its color, copper leaf must be sealed after being applied, or it will slowly tarnish. Copper leaf can also be intentionally tarnished, or antiqued, using common household chemicals, which can change its color to give it an aged appearance. Copper leaf is also available in rolls.

products.name: Palladium Leaf
facts: Genuine palladium
3-1/8 in square
loose and transfer / patent
about: Due to the war in Ukraine, supplies of refined Palladium are limited. Our genuine Palladium Leaf is 99.9% palladium. It can be used for picture frames, indoor or outdoor architectural projects, and unique artwork.

Palladium will not tarnish and is therefore ideal for outdoor projects. Palladium looks like silver leaf but can be toned down and antiqued by using special sealers with color added. If your project requires a warmer tone, consider using our 12k gold leaf. Palladium is susceptible to corrosion from chlorine and should not be used on chlorinated pools or fountains.
specs: Books of 25 leaves each, or packs of 500 leaves.

products.name: Variegated Leaf Color 2
facts: Gold, red orange and blue patterns

about: Kolner Permacoll Size Black is a water base slow size especially designed for gold and silver leaf. It does not require an activator and reaches tack in 15 to 30 minutes.

The advantage of Permacoll is that is has a long open time for applying the leaf, which can be applied for up to several days. Permacoll Size is formulated for gilding leaf on all types of nonporous, smooth or textured surfaces. Permacoll Size is for indoor applications only and is not burnishable. It should not be exposed to weather or excessive wear. Genuine gold or silver leaf will not be as bright when compared to using Instacoll Base.

products.name: Kölner Permacoll Size HA Black
facts: Kölner Permacoll Black HA (High Active) size is especially designed for copper and imitation gold and silver.
about: Kölner Permacoll Black HA (High Active) size is especially designed for copper and imitation gold and silver. It does not require an activator and has a set time of 15 to 30 minutes after which you can apply the metal leaf.

The main advantage of Permacoll HA size is its long open time. Metal leaf can be applied hours, and up to days, later. Permacoll Size HA has a higher adhesive strength than the Permacoll Size. Permacoll Size is intended for indoor applications only and should not be exposed to weather or areas that may experience excessive wear. It is formulated for gilding metal leaf on wood, nonporous, smooth or textured surfaces. Glossy surfaces should be lightly sanded or scuffed for better adhesion. Permacoll Size HA is is not burnishable.

products.name: Basic Small Double Edged Gilders Knife
facts: This Double Sided polished Stainless Steel Gilders Knife is ideal for cutting gold or other metal leaf.
about: This Double Sided polished Stainless Steel Gilders Knife is ideal for cutting gold or other metal leaf. When used properly in conjunction with a Gilders Pad/Cushion, the gold leaf will not be torn and can be easily cut to any size or shape for your gilding project.

The wooden handle is and is securely attached by rivets to the polished stainless steel blade. The overall length of the knife is 9.8 inches. The blade is 5.5 inches long and 0.7 inches wide. Before use, the blade should be cleaned with rubbing alcohol to degrease it. Avoid touching or handling the blade to keep it free of oils that will cause leaf to stick to it.

products.name: Kolner Poliment Yellow
facts: Kolner Poliment Yellow clay bole is used in water gilding.
about: Kolner Poliment Yellow clay bole is used in water gilding. It is applied on top of the gesso and enhances the tone and luster of the gold during the polishing/burnishing process.

An adhesive must be added to the Poliment, rabbit skin glue is the preferred adhesive. You can mix different Poliment colors together to achieve a custom tone to your gold. You will have an extremely bright and shiny gold leaf after burnishing the gold leaf with an agate burnisher. Poliment is mixed with Rabbit Skin Glue before use, and is applied in 2 to 4 thin layers before the gold or other leaf is applied. After completely dry, the leaf can be polished with an agate burnisher.

products.name: Kölner Squirrel Hair Gilders Tips
facts: The Kolner Premium Gilders Tips are made of 100% squirrel hair, which allows you to easily see through the…
about: The Kolner Premium Gilders Tips are made of 100% squirrel hair, which allows you to easily see through the hairs so that you can place the gold or silver leaf where you want.

The tips are ideal for picking up and placing gold or precious leaf on the item being gilded. They will not carry a static charge and will last for years. Before use, it is best to apply a very thin coat of petroleum jelly on the back of your non-dominant hand and run the end of the tip lights across the back of your hand to pick up a minute amount of the jelly. The tip will then easily pick up the leaf and you can lay it where you want it to be. The tips should be cleaned after each use, using a solvent appropriate for the adhesive that was used. It is best dried by laying it on a clean flat surface to retain its shape and make it ready for it’s next use.

The combination of its shorter bristles, fine blue squirrel hair and black synthetic hair makes scrolling easier and faster. This brush is ideal for pinstriping small script lettering. Heavy pressure to begin and lifting the brush s you drag your line will give you a long teardrop effect. A 65 to 85 degree angle will give you the best results.
